title: Community Engagement Manager, Data Centers (New York)
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is building AI systems that will shape the trajectory of one of the most consequential technologies in human history. That work requires physical infrastructure at significant scale, and building that infrastructure the right way means being a real, long-term partner to the communities where we operate.

We are looking for a Community Engagement Manager in New York to join our Public Policy team and serve as Anthropic's on-the-ground presence in the communities where our data centers are sited, built, and operated. This is not a communications role or a government affairs role, though you will do elements of both. It is a relationship role: your job is to make Anthropic a trusted, visible, and valued neighbor, from the earliest stages of site selection through construction and long-term operations.

You will be the connective tissue between Anthropic's Policy and Infrastructure teams and the local officials, community organizations, economic development partners, and residents who have a stake in what we build. You will surface concerns before they escalate, translate our technical and operational plans into clear local benefits, and build the coalitions that allow us to move quickly and responsibly. Because Anthropic's infrastructure footprint is still early in its growth, you will also help write the playbook: the processes you build in your first markets are the ones we will use as we expand.

You will travel regularly across New York State, including upstate communities, up to 50% of the time, and occasionally to other Anthropic data center markets.

Key responsibilities

•
Build and maintain trusted, sustained relationships with town, village, city, and county elected officials and administrators, planning and zoning boards, local industrial development agencies, state agencies, economic development organizations, community groups, civic leaders, labor and building trades organizations, educational institutions, and workforce partners in the New York data center markets you cover

•
Develop and execute a community engagement strategy for each of your markets, spanning site selection, pre-development, construction, and ongoing operations

•
Build external coalitions, host education and listening sessions, and design local solutions that deliver real benefits to the communities where we operate

•
Represent Anthropic in public forums, town halls, planning hearings, community events, and local media

•
Monitor community sentiment and local political dynamics, and advise internal teams on risks, opportunities, and the right pace and posture for engagement

•
Partner with the Real Estate and Infrastructure team to bring community input into how projects are planned, communicated, and delivered, not just how they are announced, including public comment and environmental review processes

•
Work with the Communications team to develop proactive, locally relevant messaging

•
Coordinate charitable giving, community investment, and economic development commitments in your markets, including managing nonprofit partner relationships

•
Partner with the Energy and Sustainability team to explain our approach to environmental stewardship and respond to questions about power, water, and land use, including how New York's energy and climate policies and grid conditions shape our plans

•
Build a community engagement playbook and repeatable processes that scale as Anthropic's infrastructure footprint grows

Minimum qualifications

•
Experience in community affairs, public affairs, economic development, government relations, local or state government, or a closely related field

title: Area Sales Manager - HVAC
description:
Category: HVAC

Location: North East United Kingdom

Our client is a well-established HVAC manufacturer, supplying air distribution solutions to commercial construction projects across the UK. With a workforce of over 250 employees, they are recognised for both product quality and technical expertise.
As part of their continued growth, the company is now seeking a Field-Based Area Sales Manager to join the external sales team and cover the North East England region.
In this role, you will:

• Develop and manage relationships across a wide range of commercial project types, including offices, healthcare, education, residential, hospitality, retail, and government buildings.

• Ensure the company’s products (e.g. diffusers, dampers, grilles, control systems) are specified, approved, and ultimately installed on new projects.

• Engage with key decision-makers throughout the route to market, including M&E consultants, main contractors, specialist subcontractors, design & build contractors, and specifiers.

This is a remote position, typically spending 3-4 days per week in the field and the remainder working from home. Project values range from £10,000 to £250,000+, with sales cycles typically spanning 6-18 months.
In addition to managing regional enquiries and driving business development, you’ll also represent the company at conferences and exhibitions alongside the National Sales Manager and Sales Director.

Requirements
We are keen to hear from:

• Candidates from a wholesale or distribution background who are looking to move into technical sales.

• Experienced specification-led sales engineers with knowledge of HVAC or related products and an understanding of the route to market, ideally gained with another manufacturer.

• Field sales experience with a wholesaler, distributor, or manufacturer within the construction industry.

• HVAC product knowledge is highly desirable, but we will also consider candidates from other technical field-based products or services such as lighting, facades, renewables, lifts & escalators, fire & security systems.

• Strong understanding of the route to market, including engagement with M&E consultants, main contractors, subcontractors, or specifiers throughout the project lifecycle.

• Comfortable working autonomously, managing your own diary and territory.

• A full UK driving licence is essential.

Benefits

• £45,000-£55,000 base salary negotiable

• OTE first year £15,000

• Company car, phone and laptop

• Good company pension

• Life insurance

Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed - we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. About Shapely

Shapely is transforming weight loss care through a physician-led, evidence-based model that makes treatment affordable and accessible. We pair clinical excellence with a seamless integrated app to help patients achieve sustainable, long-lasting results. As we scale across multiple states, we're hiring a Sales Specialist - Patient Support Coordinator to be the first point of contact for prospective patients and guide them into care.
As our Sales Specialist, you'll be the first voice many prospective patients hear. You'll connect with warm leads who have already expressed interest, help them understand our program, answer their questions about eligibility and cost, and convert that interest into a scheduled appointment. It's a consultative, phone-based sales role in a healthcare setting - equal parts persuasion and genuine care.
This is a full-time, remote contractor role on a Pacific Time (PST) schedule, with room to grow and a supportive team behind you.
What You'll Do
1. Outbound Lead Engagement - the core of the role

• Make outbound sales calls and follow-ups to prospective patients who have expressed interest in Shapely .

• Educate leads on our program, our physician-led model, and how GLP-1/GIP weight loss medications work.

• Explain insurance eligibility basics and general coverage considerations to set accurate expectations.

• Guide interested leads through enrollment and schedule their initial appointment.

2. Pipeline & Conversion Management

• Manage your pipeline of leads in the CRM, tracking follow-ups and conversion status.

• Meet or exceed targets for outbound calls, conversions, and scheduled appointments.

• Re-engage warm leads who haven't yet enrolled to answer outstanding questions and move them forward.

3. Cross-Team Coordination

• Partner with our Prior Authorization and Concierge teams to ensure a smooth handoff once a patient enrolls.

• Relay common objections, questions, and friction points to leadership to help refine our messaging and process.

Requirements

Must-Have

•
Advanced, fluent English - spoken and written. This is essential for the role. You'll be on the phone every day with patients based in the U.S., so clear, natural, and confident communication is non-negotiable.

• Proven experience in sales, telesales, or outbound calling, with a track record of meeting or exceeding conversion targets.

• A persuasive, consultative communication style that builds trust quickly over the phone.

• Previous experience in a healthcare or telehealth environment, or a similar patient-facing role.

• Knowledge of HIPAA, PHI, and patient privacy (training also provided).

• Comfortable explaining insurance eligibility and medication coverage basics to set accurate expectations.

• Resilient and self-motivated when working through a high-volume outbound pipeline.

• Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with a friendly, empathetic, customer-first approach.

• A reliable remote setup: stable high-speed internet and a quiet, private space for calls.

• Able to work full-time on Pacific Time (PST) - see schedule below.

• Nice to have: Experience with Zoom Phone, CRM platforms, or EHR systems (training also provided).

Schedule

Full-time, 40 hours per week , on Pacific Time (PST) . Our patient support team operates seven days a week.

title: Associate Systems Engineer
description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Associate Systems Support Engineer to join our IT operations team. The successful candidate will be responsible for monitoring and maintaining the performance of critical systems, ensuring the uptime and availability of applications and infrastructure. This role involves working with monitoring tools such as AppDynamics (AppD), LogicMonitor, and Azure Monitor, as well as monitoring SQL databases, Windows servers, and Internet Information Services (IIS). The Associate Systems Support Engineer will provide L1 and L2 support while ensuring compliance with service level agreements (SLAs).
Key Responsibilities

• Monitor the performance and availability of applications and infrastructure using tools such as AppDynamics, LogicMonitor, and Azure Monitor.

• Conduct regular health checks and performance tuning of SQL databases to ensure optimal operation.

• Oversee the functionality and performance of Windows servers and IIS, applying necessary configurations and updates as needed.

• Monitor interface subsystems to ensure seamless data flow and connectivity between systems.

• Provide first-level support for system incidents, diagnosing issues and escalating problems to higher-level engineering teams when necessary.

• Maintain documentation related to system configurations, procedures, and incident responses.

• Participate in root cause analysis (RCA) for incidents to prevent future occurrences and improve system reliability.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement system upgrades, patches, and configurations while minimizing downtime.

• Ensure 24/7 uptime of critical systems, responding quickly to alerts and incidents to meet predefined SLAs.

• Stay updated with industry trends and best practices to recommend improvements to monitoring processes and tools.

Key Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

• 1-3 years of experience in a systems monitoring and support role.

• Familiarity with application performance monitoring tools such as AppDynamics, LogicMonitor, and Azure Monitor.

• Basic knowledge of SQL databases, including monitoring and troubleshooting techniques.

• Understanding of Windows Server administration and IIS management.

• Experience with monitoring server uptime, performance metrics, and alert management.

• Proficient in troubleshooting system issues and performing root cause analysis.

• Strong analytical skills and attention to detail to ensure high-quality service delivery.

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

• Availability to work in a 24x7 environment (9 Hours or 12 Hours shift), including evenings, weekends, and on-call rotations as required.

Preferred Qualifications

• Understanding of monitoring tools like AppDynamics and LogicMonitor.

• Understanding of healthcare application is an added advantage.

• Knowledge of ITIL best practices and frameworks.

title: Data Technical Trainer
description:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

The Opportunity

As an instructor, you will be responsible for the delivery of our technical content and supporting our apprentices in upskilling in these technical areas through workshops and drop in sessions. You will help apprentices develop the appropriate Knowledge, Skills & Behaviours throughout their programme.

The Multiverse delivery team is a diverse mix of industry experts, educators, and academics, working together to build the future of work. You will be part of this team, reporting to a Delivery Lead who will guide your development.

To ensure a strong start, you will complete a 3-week onboarding programme, covering:

- Modern teaching methodologies - for a hands-on, engaging learning experience

- Technical upskilling - to align with the relevant apprenticeship standard

- Practical coaching opportunities - a rigorous, robust feedback process to get you ready to launch your programme

At the end of onboarding, you will be ready to support Multiverse apprentices, helping them develop technical expertise and industry-relevant skills relating to AI and Data domains and drive impact within their businesses. We believe this is an opportunity like no other!

Specifically, you will:

- Confidently facilitate delivery sessions of our technical Learning content, ensuring the session delivers against learning objectives within the allotted time.

- Adhere to the Coach Quality framework to ensure a consistent level of quality for every session and a consistent experience for every apprentice.

- Create a vibrant, inclusive and motivating environment that drives apprentice learning, engagement and overall satisfaction.

- Moderate assignments in line with mark schemes to ensure quality and consistency while providing feedback and feed forward for apprentices to continually develop their technical and durable skills.

- Maintain an owners mentality, whether assigned a learner or in support of other coaches, being proactive in taking action, sharing feedback, or providing support to ensure the progress and success of learners.

- Regularly liaise with coaches to align on apprentice interventions to ensure successful completion of programme.

- Coordinate with cohort coaches and operations members to align on apprentice development and progress.

- Utilise resources & learning opportunities provided by Multiverse, stay up-to-date on knowledge, learning and product updates, to ensure you are equipped to support your apprentices.

- Build & maintain credibility with your apprentices by utilising a mixture of professional experience, program/domain/industry knowledge and client context in your interactions.

We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world.

• Managing the day-to-day DTC roadmap: prioritizing, sequencing, and helping unblock work across the Shopify site, checkout, and post-purchase experiences

• Mapping the end-to-end customer journey and using analytics, session data, and customer feedback to find friction and the highest-value opportunities

• Breaking down business requirements into clear user stories and acceptance criteria, and working with Engineering and development partners to ship in Agile sprints on Shopify (themes, apps, and checkout)

title: Head of Capital
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

The opportunity

We are looking for a Head of Capital to run how Relay raises equity and works with its investors: the next round and the ones after it, from the investor map to the close, next to the CEO.

Relay is a technology enabled parcel carrier - we deliver parcels from retailers to end customers but do it much more efficiently than incumbents. This efficiency has propelled us into one of the fastest growing companies in Europe - we have grown over 40x in the last 18 months. The capital Relay raises decides how fast the network grows and what it can promise retailers. Raising it well, from the right investors, on terms we understand, is a job in its own right.

About the role

The capital we raise next decides how fast the network grows and what it can promise retailers. Our next round is planned for Q2/Q3 2027. It is for growth, from growth-stage investors, and it will be won on evidence. Today a raise runs through the CEO and the CFO alongside their day jobs. It works. It is however, not a system.

You will be the person who makes it one. You will not just be the person who holds and runs the Series C transaction, but also be the Head of the Office that will build the systems to raise multiple rounds of capital in the future. Between rounds you keep the map, the materials and the investors warm, so each raise starts from a record, not a blank page. Few roles let you own how a growing company raises the capital it runs on, from the inside, round after round.

Who you work with

- CEO: you report here. The CEO pitches and takes the decisions on a round.

- CFO: you work together daily. The CFO owns the budget, the forecast, internal finance and any debt. You own equity, the investors behind it, and the investor-facing model built from the CFO's numbers - never a second set.

- Co-founder and the Extended Leadership Team: the proof a round needs.

- External & Internal Counsel: terms and the close.

- Board: updates between rounds and approval on the round.

What you'll do

Running the transaction with the CEO & CFO

1. Build the investor map: which funds, which partner at each, why each fits us, in what order we go, and the warm path to each.

2. The process start to close: the timeline, outreach, a brief before every meeting and notes after, investor questions answered within a day, and diligence.

3. Put term sheets side by side and show what each costs in the round after. Draw up illustrative analysis and counsel the CEO on the right strategy.

4. Hold the story in one version, drafted with the CEO. The same claims and numbers across the deck, the model and the data room.

5. Own the investor-facing model: scenarios, unit economics and use of funds. Every number ties to one the CFO has signed.

Between rounds

1. Refresh the deck, the KPI pack and the data room every quarter.

2. Write investor and board updates. Answer existing investors' questions. Track what we promised them.

title: Commercial Sales Development Representative
description:
About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

Position Summary:

The Commercial Sales Development Representative (C-SDR) at Delinea is a full-time, hybrid, position based at our Boston location (100 Summer Street). As an entry-level position, this role serves as a vital connection between our Sales and Marketing teams, focusing on generating and qualifying leads to create business opportunities. 2. Lead Qualification: Process and qualify inbound leads to generate sales opportunities, ensuring alignment with Delinea's sales goals.

3. Pipeline Development: Execute a minimum of 75+ outbound activities daily, including calls and emails, to build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified leads.

La mission porte sur le pilotage et la mise en œuvre d’un programme de gestion des risques liés aux tiers (TPRM) dans le cadre de NIS2. Vous intervenez sur la gouvernance, les analyses de risques fournisseurs et l’intégration du dispositif dans les processus de l’organisation.
1. Finalisation du cadrage et de la gouvernance

• Poursuivre la définition du modèle de gouvernance TPRM et accompagner l’adoption des rôles et responsabilités associés.

• Contribuer à la formalisation de la politique, de la procédure et du framework de gestion des risques liés aux tiers.

• Définir et structurer les outils nécessaires au dispositif : inventaire des fournisseurs, critères de criticité, questionnaires d’impact et de maturité, registre des risques, plans d’action et supports de reporting.

• Assurer le suivi de l’avancement et le reporting auprès du CISO et des instances de gouvernance.

2. Préparation et mise en œuvre du dispositif

• Contribuer à l’inventaire des fournisseurs critiques ainsi qu’à l’évaluation de leur criticité et de leurs dépendances métier et IT.

• Mener ou accompagner les analyses de risques fournisseurs, formaliser les risques et suivre les plans de traitement et de remédiation.

• Définir une approche proportionnée pour l’évaluation et le monitoring des tiers, en fonction de leur niveau de criticité et de risque.

• Contribuer à la définition et à l’intégration des exigences de sécurité dans les processus d’achats, de projets et de contractualisation.

• Accompagner le déploiement du dispositif sur des périmètres pilotes, notamment au moyen d’analyses de risques, de comités fournisseurs, de collectes d’évidences et, le cas échéant, d’audits ciblés.

• Tirer les enseignements des pilotes afin d’améliorer le modèle de gouvernance, les méthodes et l’outillage.

3. Passage à l’échelle et coordination transverse

• Préparer l’extension progressive du dispositif aux autres fournisseurs critiques, puis aux fournisseurs sensibles et aux nouveaux marchés, selon le périmètre retenu pour le dispositif.

• Collaborer avec les équipes Achats, Juridique, Protection des données, Projets, Processus et CISO afin d’ancrer le TPRM dans les processus existants et les nouveaux marchés.

• Animer les ateliers, les entretiens et les comités avec les parties prenantes internes et les fournisseurs.

• Préparer des synthèses claires sur l’avancement, les décisions attendues, les risques, les plans d’action et les points ouverts.

• Contribuer à la formation et à la sensibilisation des parties prenantes afin de pérenniser le dispositif.

📝 Votre profil

• Maîtrise de NIS2 et du référentiel CyFun® ou de NIST CSF.

• Expérience des pratiques de gestion des risques liés aux tiers sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie fournisseur.

• Expérience dans le secteur de l’énergie ou des infrastructures critiques.

• Expérience de la coordination avec les équipes Achats, Juridique, métiers et IT/Sécurité.

• Expérience démontrable dans l’analyse, notamment dans l’analyse des risques de sécurité de l’information.

• Expérience démontrable en conseil ou en gestion GRC en cybersécurité.

• Expérience démontrable en pilotage de programmes ou de projets de sécurité.

• Expérience démontrable en tant que consultant en sécurité.

• Expérience dans le suivi des plans de traitement et de remédiation des risques.

• Expérience en évaluation de maturité ou de conformité sur la base d’un référentiel de contrôles.

• Français niveau C2.

• Expérience dans l’animation d’ateliers et de comités ainsi que dans le reporting auprès d’instances de pilotage.

• Expérience avec la méthodologie EBIOS.

title: Quantitative Researcher, Marketplace
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay makes millions of dynamic, interconnected decisions across its network every day, and each one shapes the experience of the thousands of couriers who work with us. Knowing what any one of those decisions actually did is hard: couriers interfere with each other, effects vary from person to person, and the outcomes that matter compound over time.

Science at Relay is the brain of the operation: machine learning, operational research, recommender systems, causal inference, location intelligence and experimentation, working together to decide how every parcel gets delivered. You'll lead causal inference at Relay from the start.

CAUSAL INFERENCE HIGHLIGHTS

- A live, two-sided marketplace to experiment in, with every decision logged across millions of parcels.

- Interference between couriers, heterogeneous effects and long-term outcomes are the norm here, not the exception.

- Four marketplaces, each with its own app and its own economics.

- Your insights and models feed straight into Relay's network-wide optimisation.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Quantitative Researcher at Relay, you'll:

- Set the standard for causal inference at Relay.

- Measure how our decisions affect each courier, today and over time.

- Shape how Relay experiments across a live, two-sided marketplace.

- Adapt advanced techniques across causal inference, statistics and machine learning to Relay's problems, and see them through to production.

- Partner with Operational Research to embed your insights and models into Relay's network-wide optimisation, and help build our research culture and voice in the tech community.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO…

- Bring deep expertise in causal inference, experimentation and machine learning, whether from a PhD, publications, or years at the frontier in industry.

- Come from statistics, an experimental science such as biology or psychology, or quantitative research.

- Have applied advanced techniques to real marketplaces or products, and owned the outcome.

- Think in mechanisms, and let evidence guide decisions.

- Are energised by open, interconnected problems, and know how to find the signal.

- Collaborate generously, and explain complex ideas simply.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

- Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

- Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

title: Product Manager - Postgres
description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Product Manager to own Postgres itself at Supabase. Every Supabase project is a full Postgres database, and Postgres is the foundation that Auth, Storage, Realtime and Edge Functions run on. You'll own the product experience of the database: Postgres versions and upgrades, maintenance, observability, extensions and security.

You'll work closely with our Postgres engineering teams and with the PM lead for Databases, who leads Multigres https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PxlZssDNrws. You'll define the Postgres requirements that architecture must meet, and own how customers experience their database through that transition.

This role is ideal for someone who loves Postgres, sweats the details that make a database trustworthy, and is excited about improving the experience for millions of developers. Small improvements here compound across every project on the platform.

WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

- You'll own Postgres versions, upgrades and end-of-life. Which major and minor versions we support, how and when customers upgrade, and how we retire old versions. Your goal is to make upgrades routine rather than risky.

- You'll make maintenance predictable. You'll design how we schedule, communicate and run maintenance windows so customers stay informed and in control, and disruption is rare and expected.

- You'll help developers understand their database. Query performance, metrics, logs and advisors: you'll own the path from "my database is slow" to the fix.

- You'll own our extension ecosystem. Which extensions we offer, how we evaluate and support new ones, and how we keep them working across versions.

- You'll own Postgres security. Roles and permissions, Row Level Security ergonomics, secure defaults, and how we respond to Postgres and extension CVEs.

- You'll talk to developers across the full spectrum, from indie developers on their first project to enterprises running critical workloads, and bring what you learn into every prioritization call.

- You'll own the problem definition, requirements and success metrics for what we ship, such as upgrade success rate, the share of the fleet on supported versions, and time-to-diagnose for performance problems. You'll set the metric before the team builds, then track it after launch.

- You'll keep Engineering, Support and GTM aligned. You'll own the plan of record for what's coming, why, and in what order, and communicate version changes and deprecations clearly to customers.

YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

MUST HAVE

- 4+ years of Product Management experience on databases, developer tools or infrastructure, or equivalent depth as an engineer, DBA or founder moving into product. You're comfortable commenting on an architecture doc and advocating for the user when trade-offs are required.

- Know Postgres well, or another relational database well enough to ramp quickly. You're comfortable reading EXPLAIN output and talking about replication, WAL, roles and extensions.

- Have shipped products where reliability and trust are the experience. You treat downtime and breaking changes as product problems, not just operational ones.

- Write clearly. Your specs, announcements and deprecation notices leave little room for confusion.

- Build with what you own. You run queries, test upgrades and try extensions yourself, and form opinions through first-hand use.

- Use AI to move faster. You use AI tools to compress research, drafting and feedback synthesis so you spend more time on judgment calls.

- Work async by default. Supabase is fully remote. You make decisions in writing and move work forward without meetings.

STRONG SIGNAL

- Worked on a managed database service.

- Ran P

Admin and CRM work is a lower priority at the start and grows only if outreach creates more follow-up. Attitude and learning speed matter more than existing expertise.

The client is a Sydney-based energy markets consultancy that analyses global oil and energy markets, including crude oil and petrochemicals. Its analysts are regularly quoted by international business and financial media. LinkedIn is an important channel for building the founder's profile, staying close to the market, and starting conversations with prospective clients and industry contacts.

Lead Generation & Outreach (Email & LinkedIn)

than focusing on rapid follower growth.

• Research and build targeted prospect lists based on the founder's ideal client profile.

• Send personalised connection requests and LinkedIn messages to potential clients.

• Write and send cold email campaigns and multi-step follow-up sequences.

• Track replies, manage follow-ups, and book discovery calls directly into the founder's

calendar.

• Maintain accurate lead records and pipeline stages in the CRM or tracking sheet.

• Report weekly on outreach activity: messages sent, response rate, meetings booked.

• Cold calling is not an expectation of this role; outreach is done through LinkedIn and

email.

(posts, carousels, polls, articles, and short videos).

• Draft, schedule, and publish posts in the founder's voice for review and approval,

adapting content for other platforms where needed.

• Turn the founder's notes or emails into LinkedIn posts, captions, graphics, and videos,

with the founder providing direction on what to post.

track engagement, flag useful activity, and respond or flag items that need the

founder's attention.

• Extend content and engagement to other platforms such as X, Instagram, and YouTube

as the role develops, with LinkedIn remaining the main focus.

Market Intelligence from LinkedIn

• Follow target people and companies and monitor what they post or write.

• Summarise useful insights and flag activity worth acting on.

• Share links or brief updates with the founder.

Canva Graphics & Video Creation

• Design on-brand graphics for LinkedIn and other social platforms, including post

images, carousels, quote cards, and banners.

• Create and edit short videos for LinkedIn and other social platforms (trimming, captions, branding, music, and transitions).

• Use the existing brand kit to create graphics and videos, and maintain reusable

templates (colours, fonts, logos) to keep branding consistent.

• Organise and store all creative assets in a structured folder system.

Admin & Support Lower priority at the start; expected to grow if outreach succeeds and creates more follow-up work.

• Manage the founder's calendar, appointments, and meeting schedules.

• Screen emails and correspondence; draft professional replies.

• Prepare meeting agendas, notes, and action item follow-ups.

• Update the CRM and maintain organised digital files and contact records.

• Support ad hoc projects and process improvements.

• Track time worked and report progress regularly, flagging what is done, pending, or

blocked.

title: Growth Product Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Growth Product Marketing team helps people discover, adopt, and get lasting value from ChatGPT’s consumer paid plans. We partner with Product and teams across Marketing to turn customer insight into subscriber and revenue growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a senior product marketer to own growth marketing strategy and execution for ChatGPT’s consumer paid plans. You’ll partner closely with Growth Product to turn customer insight into experiments and campaigns, bringing deep expertise in pricing, packaging, and monetization. You’ll own revenue and growth goals across conversion, activation, engagement, retention, and upgrades.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Lead product marketing for pricing and packaging, using research to inform tiers, features, and offers. Lead coordinated launches and customer communications for pricing and plan changes.

- Own positioning and value propositions for paid plans, using customer research, behavioral data, and competitive insight to define audiences, plan differentiation, and priority use cases.

- Turn new product capabilities into reasons to subscribe, engage, or upgrade. Drive hands-on execution across in-product experiences, pricing pages, email, and push, writing briefs and copy and coordinating channel owners.

- Develop and test promotions and growth campaigns that drive paid conversion and upgrades, owning audience strategy, messaging, and measurement.

- Build lifecycle programs that improve onboarding, feature adoption, engagement, retention, and winback.

- Partner with Data Science and Finance to measure incremental growth and revenue impact, and use results to scale, improve, or stop programs.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

- Have 10+ years of experience in product marketing, growth, or monetization, including substantial experience with subscriptions.

- Bring deep experience in pricing and packaging, from research and recommendations through launch, with measurable business impact.

- Have led product marketing for subscriptions, with direct ownership of revenue and growth goals across paid conversion, activation, retention, and upgrades. Bring fluency in funnels, cohort analysis, experimentation, and subscription economics.

- Combine clear positioning and strong writing with hands-on delivery of briefs, messaging, and campaigns that make complex products easy to understand.

- Set direction independently, align senior stakeholders, and unblock delivery across teams. You’re hands-on, responsive to evidence, and committed to customer trust.

LOCATION:

- San Francisco, CA. This role requires a hybrid schedule with an in office requirement from Monday - Wednesday.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. title: Walmart Lister
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Walmart Listing Specialist to manage and optimize product listings on the Walmart Marketplace. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with Walmart Seller Center and understands how to create accurate, compliant, and high-converting listings that improve product visibility and drive sales.
This role requires someone who is organized, proactive, and capable of managing large product catalogs while maintaining listing accuracy and marketplace compliance.
Key Responsibilities
Product Listing Management

• Create, upload, and maintain product listings on Walmart Marketplace

• Set up new products, including titles, descriptions, bullet points, attributes, and categories

• Manage product variations such as size, color, and style

• Perform bulk uploads and catalog updates as needed

• Ensure all listing information is accurate and up to date

Listing Optimization

• Optimize product titles, descriptions, key features, and keywords to improve visibility and conversions

• Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis

• Improve listing quality scores and identify opportunities for optimization

• Monitor product performance and recommend strategies to increase sales

Walmart Seller Center Management

• Navigate and manage daily tasks within Walmart Seller Center

• Troubleshoot listing errors, unpublished items, and suppression issues

• Monitor listing health and compliance with Walmart Marketplace policies

• Coordinate with Walmart Seller Support to resolve account and catalog issues

Inventory & Pricing Updates

• Update inventory quantities and pricing information

• Monitor stock availability and communicate inventory concerns

• Ensure pricing remains competitive while maintaining profitability

Reporting & Analysis

• Track listing performance and marketplace metrics

• Prepare reports on catalog status, sales trends, and optimization efforts

• Identify opportunities to improve product visibility and conversion rates

Qualifications

• Proven experience managing Walmart Marketplace listings

• Strong knowledge of Walmart Seller Center

• Experience with product listing optimization and catalog management

• Familiarity with Walmart Marketplace guidelines and compliance requirements

• Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

• Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities

• Excellent written communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with other ecommerce platforms such as Amazon, eBay, or Shopify

• Knowledge of marketplace SEO and keyword optimization

• Experience with bulk listing tools and inventory management systems

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets

Required Software & Tools

• Walmart Seller Center

• Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets

• Inventory or listing management tools (if applicable)

Employment Type

• Full-Time - 9 AM - 5 PM EST

• Remote
